description: Structured eval definitions for the Macie Data Discovery Operator. Five-case proven set exercising the READY / BLOCKED / COMPLETED classification across operation types (enable Macie org-level delegated admin, create scheduled classification job, Macie not enabled blocked, custom regex data identifier, auto-remediation via Step Functions completed). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Enable Macie at org level with delegated admin account
eval_cases.branch: READY — org-level Macie enablement with delegated admin 123456789012, auto-enable for new members, FIFTEEN_MINUTES frequency
eval_cases.prompt: Enable Amazon Macie for our AWS Organization. We want account 123456789012 as the delegated Macie administrator. The management account is 123456789012. Configure auto-enable for all new member accounts. Set finding publish frequency to FIFTEEN_MINUTES. We have 5 member accounts currently. Region: us-east-1. Provide the full enablement procedure with pre-checks and post-verification.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPERATION: enable
VERDICT: READY
TARGET: macie-org-enablement
PRE_CHECKS:
  - [PASS] Management account 123456789012 has organizations:EnableAWSServiceAccess permission
  - [PASS] Target admin account 123456789012 exists and is a member of the org
  - [PASS] No existing delegated admin (get-administrator-account returns NotFoundException)
STEPS:
  1. CONFIRM: About to enable Macie org-level with delegated admin 123456789012. Proceed? (yes/no)
  2. aws macie2 enable-organization-admin-account --admin-account-id 123456789012
  3. aws macie2 enable-macie-session --finding-publishing-frequency FIFTEEN_MINUTES --status ENABLED
  4. aws macie2 update-organization-configuration --auto-enable true
POST_VERIFY: (pending execution)
STATE: pending — Macie will be ENABLED with org-level delegated admin
NOTES: Auto-enable true means new member accounts get Macie automatically. Existing 5 member accounts need explicit invitation or auto-enable retroactively.

eval_cases.name: Create scheduled daily classification job with RECOMMENDED identifiers
eval_cases.branch: READY — daily scheduled classification job on prod-data-bucket and financial-records with RECOMMENDED managed identifiers
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Macie classification job named "daily-pii-scan" for our production data buckets: prod-data-bucket and financial-records. Account: 123456789012. Use RECOMMENDED managed data identifier selector. Daily schedule. Macie is already enabled with FIFTEEN_MINUTES finding publish frequency. Region: us-east-1. Provide the full procedure with pre-checks and post-verification.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPERATION: classify
VERDICT: READY
TARGET: daily-pii-scan
PRE_CHECKS:
  - [PASS] Macie session ENABLED (get-macie-session status=ENABLED)
  - [PASS] Target bucket prod-data-bucket exists in account 123456789012
  - [PASS] Target bucket financial-records exists in account 123456789012
  - [PASS] IAM role has macie2:CreateClassificationJob permission
STEPS:
  1. CONFIRM: About to create scheduled classification job daily-pii-scan. Proceed? (yes/no)
  2. aws macie2 create-classification-job --name daily-pii-scan --job-type SCHEDULED --schedule-frequency '{dailySchedule:{}}' --s3-job-definition bucketDefinitions='[{accountId=123456789012,buckets=[prod-data-bucket,financial-records]}]' --managed-data-identifier-selector RECOMMENDED --description "Daily PII scan of production data buckets"
POST_VERIFY: (pending execution)
STATE: pending — job will be RUNNING after creation, COMPLETE after first scan cycle
NOTES: RECOMMENDED selector lets Macie sample bucket content and select relevant identifiers. Job runs daily. Findings published at FIFTEEN_MINUTES frequency.

eval_cases.name: Classification job blocked — Macie not enabled
eval_cases.branch: BLOCKED — Macie session not enabled in target account; pre-flight gate catches missing enablement
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Macie classification job named "pii-scan-2026-08" on the bucket sensitive-data-prod. Account: 123456789012. One-time scan for USA_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER and CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER. We think Macie is enabled but aren't sure. Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPERATION: classify
VERDICT: BLOCKED
TARGET: pii-scan-2026-08
PRE_CHECKS:
  - [FAIL] Macie session NOT ENABLED — get-macie-session returns NotFoundException. Macie must be enabled before creating classification jobs.
STEPS: (none — pre-checks failed)
POST_VERIFY: (none)
STATE: Macie disabled
NOTES: Enable Macie first: aws macie2 enable-macie-session --finding-publishing-frequency FIFTEEN_MINUTES --status ENABLED.

eval_cases.name: Custom data identifier with regex for employee ID format
eval_cases.branch: READY — custom regex data identifier for EMP###### employee ID with proximity keywords and ignore words
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Macie custom data identifier named "employee-id-pattern" that detects our internal employee ID format EMP###### (EMP followed by 6 digits). Use proximity keywords: employee, emp_id, staff, id. Ignore test/sample data: example, test, sample, demo. Maximum match distance 50 characters. Severity HIGH. Account: 123456789012. Region: us-east-1. Provide the full procedure.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPERATION: custom-id
VERDICT: READY
TARGET: employee-id-pattern
PRE_CHECKS:
  - [PASS] Macie session ENABLED
  - [PASS] Regex pattern EMP[0-9]{6} is valid PCRE
  - [PASS] Keywords provided (employee, emp_id, staff, id) — proximity scoping active
  - [PASS] Ignore words provided (example, test, sample, demo) — test data excluded
STEPS:
  1. CONFIRM: About to create custom data identifier employee-id-pattern. Proceed? (yes/no)
  2. aws macie2 create-custom-data-identifier --name employee-id-pattern --regex "EMP[0-9]{6}" --keywords employee emp_id staff id --ignore-words example test sample demo --maximum-match-distance 50 --severity-levels HIGH --description "Detects EMP###### employee ID format"
POST_VERIFY: (pending execution)
STATE: pending — custom identifier available for classification jobs immediately
NOTES: Proximity keywords reduce false positives. Without keywords, every EMP###### match is reported. Reference this identifier in future classification jobs via --custom-data-identifier-ids.

eval_cases.name: Verify Macie + Step Functions auto-remediation integration (COMPLETED)
eval_cases.branch: COMPLETED — EventBridge + Step Functions remediation verified: test finding triggered object quarantine and SNS notification
eval_cases.prompt: We already have Macie enabled and Step Functions state machine macie-remediation-workflow deployed. The EventBridge rule macie-finding-trigger routes high-severity Macie findings to the Step Functions workflow. Verify the integration is working: we generated a test finding (sensitiveData:S3Object/Credit_Card on a public bucket), and the workflow quarantined the object and sent an SNS notification. Confirm post-verification passed. Account: 123456789012. Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPERATION: remediate
VERDICT: COMPLETED
TARGET: macie-remediation-workflow
PRE_CHECKS:
  - [PASS] Macie session ENABLED
  - [PASS] Step Functions state machine macie-remediation-workflow exists and is ACTIVE
  - [PASS] EventBridge rule macie-finding-trigger routes to Step Functions
  - [PASS] Test finding sensitiveData:S3Object/Credit_Card generated on public bucket
STEPS:
  1. (verification only — no state-changing operation)
  2. aws stepfunctions describe-execution --execution-arn <exec-arn> (confirmed SUCCEEDED)
POST_VERIFY:
  - [PASS] Step Functions execution SUCCEEDED for test finding
  - [PASS] Object quarantined (moved to isolated bucket macie-quarantine)
  - [PASS] SNS notification sent to security team topic
  - [PASS] Source bucket ACL restricted (public access blocked)
STATE: Remediation workflow verified and operational
NOTES: EventBridge triggers on high-severity Macie findings only. Step Functions handles multi-step remediation: parse finding, quarantine object, restrict ACL, notify. The workflow is idempotent — duplicate findings do not re-quarantine.
